label.purpose: Dates, targets, streaks, outcomes, and state labels.

motion.name: state-standard
motion.purpose: Hover, focus, and disclosure state changes.

components.name: Week Navigation
components.description: Centered previous/next week chevrons around the year and week range; no habit count.
components.css: .ds-week-nav { width: 32px; height: 32px; border: 0; border-radius: 6px; background: transparent; color: #666; font-size: 22px; line-height: 1; cursor: pointer; } .ds-week-nav:hover { background: #282828; color: #dadada; } .ds-week-nav:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid #8a5cf5; outline-offset: 1px; }

components.name: Primary Create
components.description: The only filled primary action, used to create a habit.
components.css: .ds-primary { height: 30px; padding: 0 12px; border: 1px solid #8a5cf5; border-radius: 6px; background: #8a5cf5; color: #1c1c1c; font: 550 10.5px/1 Inter, sans-serif; cursor: pointer; } .ds-primary:hover { background: #9467ef; } .ds-primary:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid #8a5cf5; outline-offset: 1px; }

components.name: Day Toggle
components.description: Seven interactive day cells; consecutive completions form unlabeled capsules.
components.css: .ds-day { position: relative; display: flex; align-items: center; justify-content: center; width: 100%; height: 58px; cursor: pointer; } .ds-day input { position: absolute; inset: 0; width: 100%; height: 100%; margin: 0; opacity: 0; cursor: pointer; } .ds-day-mark { display: block; width: 100%; height: 26px; border-radius: 13px; background: var(--ht-habit-color, #8a5cf5); } .ds-day::before { content: ''; position: absolute; top: 50%; right: 0; left: 0; height: 36px; border-radius: 18px; transform: translateY(-50%); } .ds-day:hover::before { background: #282828; } .ds-day:has(input:focus-visible)::before { box-shadow: inset 0 0 0 2px #8a5cf5; }

components.name: Habit Meta
components.description: Habit name with target, streak, and weekly outcome in small text.
components.css: .ds-habit { display: grid; gap: 2px; width: 240px; color: #dadada; font-family: Inter, sans-serif; } .ds-habit strong { font-size: 13.5px; font-weight: 560; line-height: 1.25; } .ds-habit span { color: #666; font-size: 10px; line-height: 1.35; }

components.name: Disclosure
components.description: Hairline-top disclosure used only for habit management; New habit stays visible.
components.css: .ds-disclosure { border-top: 1px solid #333; margin-top: 10px; color: #b3b3b3; font: 11px/1.2 Inter, sans-serif; } .ds-disclosure summary { padding: 9px 2px; cursor: pointer; list-style: none; } .ds-disclosure summary::-webkit-details-marker { display: none; } .ds-disclosure summary::before { content: '›'; display: inline-block; margin-right: 7px; transition: transform 140ms ease; } .ds-disclosure[open] summary::before { transform: rotate(90deg); } .ds-disclosure summary:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid #8a5cf5; outline-offset: 1px; }

narrative.overview: The dashboard is one week seen as a single quiet strip. It behaves like a studio wall chart: names stay in place, seven dates run across, and consistency appears as connected marks rather than badges or scores. The surrounding Obsidian chrome remains familiar; the plugin earns its character through density, rhythm, and one accent.
keyCharacteristics: One Monday-Sunday week, exactly seven columns, no monthly calendar.
Habit names left; compact target, streak, and status text underneath.
Completion runs are continuous unlabeled capsules; progress stays textual.
The year is a small centered label above the week range; crossing years name both.
Centered header with arrows, no habit count, and no More/manual Refresh menu.
New habit stays visible; successful changes are quiet, errors and conflicts are explicit.
Hairlines and tonal layering instead of cards, shadows, or decorative chrome.

rules.name: The Theme Accent Rule
rules.body: The theme accent marks completion by default, plus the current day/week and primary create action. An optional per-habit color may replace the accent only for that habit's completion marks; invalid or absent values fall back to the theme accent.

rules.name: The Theme Ownership Rule
rules.body: Runtime colors come from Obsidian variables. The hex values here are a dark-theme reference, not a replacement palette.

rules.name: The Quiet Label Rule
rules.body: Metadata is small and muted but never hidden or color-only. Status is always written in words.

rules.name: The Header-Only Week Marker
rules.body: Current-week emphasis is a faint accent band behind the seven day headers, plus the This week context label and today's date marker. Header labels keep normal text color and body cells keep the ground tone; no column tint.

rules.name: The Quiet Success Rule
rules.body: Routine successful changes do not raise a persistent banner. Errors and conflicts remain visible in text; the latest unmark keeps a discreet undo control.

dos: Do keep one week, exactly seven date columns, and habits in rows.
Do draw consecutive completions as connected capsules without count labels.
Do keep target, streak, and weekly outcome visible in words.
Do use the theme accent by default and apply an optional habit color only to that habit.
Do keep the year smaller and centered above the visible week range.
Do keep New habit visible and refresh automatically.
Do reserve banners for errors and conflicts, with a discreet in-session undo control.
Do preserve focus, keyboard access, touch targets, and progressive disclosure where it earns its place.
donts: Don't add a monthly grid, month selector, or all-weeks table as the primary view.
Don't turn weeks into separate cards or nest cards.
Don't use color alone for completion, state, or errors.
Don't hide target, streak, or weekly outcome behind hover-only affordances.
Don't replace native checkboxes, summaries, or form controls with custom div controls.
